title: BurstProfiler: multi-window KV prefix cache throughput vs p95 regression detector
creator: Marina Liu
description: Goal: Build a production-oriented harness (BurstProfiler) that exercises mixed-length traffic bursts across configurable time windows to simultaneously measure tokens/sec, p95 latency, and KV prefix cache occupancy. The harness must produce correlated time-series artifacts that feed our regression detector and support per-model and per-deployment SLO projection. Motivation: existing KV tests focus on steady-state sweeps (hit-rate vs mem) but miss short-lived burst patterns that cause 10-100x p95 regressions in production. Approach: run multi-window traffic (1s/10s/60s windows) with synthetic and sampled production fingerprints, instrument token throughput, kv cache occupancy, eviction churn, and end-to-end p95. Export artifacts to S3/Grafana and feed the regression detector which computes delta from baseline using a weighted multi-window metric (emphasize short-window p95), then raise alerts when regression > threshold and accompanied by hit-rate drop or eviction spike.
acceptance_criteria: BurstProfiler can generate mixed-length traffic profiles (short, medium, long) and map tokens/sec vs p95 vs kv-occupancy per-window
Output artifacts: time-series CSV/Parquet and Grafana dashboard panels for 1s/10s/60s windows published to runtime-perf namespace
Regression detector plugin consumes artifacts and produces an actionable alert with cause hints (hit-rate drop, eviction spike, kernel slowdown) using the weighted multi-window score
End-to-end test verifies detection on two synthetic regressions (eviction-driven and kernel-induced) with >90% precision and <2 false positives over 200 runs
Documentation (confluence) with runbook for interpreting alerts and recommended mitigations (increase cache, change batching, quantization fallback)
tasks: Design multi-window weighting metric and define thresholds (short-window weight=0.6, medium=0.3, long=0.1)
Implement traffic generator supporting sample replays, synthetic Zipfian hotkey mixes, and variable seq-len distributions
Instrument runtime to export per-request kv hit/miss, eviction events, tokens emitted, and end-to-end latency with precise timestamps
Build processing pipeline to align events into 1s/10s/60s windows and produce normalized artifacts
Integrate regression detector and wire alerts to #perf-alerts with enrichment payload (dashboard link, top contributing metrics)
Create Grafana dashboard template and automated report generator for CI runs
Add CI job that runs BurstProfiler nightly against canary cluster and stores artifacts in S3 for historical trend analysis
updates: 2026-02-15 - Ticket created by Marina. Initial design doc attached. Goal scoped to multi-window detection rather than wholesale replacement of existing harnesses.

2026-02-28 - Design review with SRE and runtime teams. Decided to weight short windows heavier to prioritize burst-induced regressions. SRE requested inclusion of eviction churn metric. Action: add eviction counters to telemetry (Ravi)
